info.name: DAtuviSezaH
info.value: ayaM DAtuH sakarmakaH asti . yaTA - 'gaNgA yamunAM milati' iti . DAtupAWe vidyamAnaH 'mil saNgame' 6.165 iti aparaH DAtuH tu akarmakaH asti .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to join, to unite, to meet

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: Sleze milet saNgame tu milate milatIti ca ' (Slo. 160) - devaH .

examples: 'unmilanti kuhUH kuhUriti kalottAlAH pikAnAM giraH' (gIta0 1.47). unmilanti uccakErmilanti suzWu Slizyanti iti vivakzati. AScaryamiva mileryoga udaH prayogaH.
